sockets.behavior: Wall only; shared four-edge power load Rs=.1 ohm. Nearest in-range matching Lamp Supply profile wins even when disabled. Active profile connects the actual supply load through a symmetric .1 ohm resistor, permitting physical reverse power flow. Both types have the original 300 V nominal watchdog, 390 V limits, 75 V-second randomized tolerance and first-excursion joker. Configured base range plus cable count; no chunk forcing.
sockets.graphics: Original PowerSocket SocketBase and type-specific Socket50V/Socket200V; original low-current cable texture/size and original dye palette, socket tint .7*color+.3. Upright wall frame. Flat original inventory sprites and held meshes.

paint.behavior: Sixteen original metadata colors. 32 life per brush stack, only decrement on changed paint; dry survival brush does nothing, creative paint is infinite. Cable/socket color and cable color-care persisted. Wrench toggles cable/bus care. NodeBase compatibility requires equal colors only when both endpoints care. Neutral devices accept any color.
paint.recipes: craftBrush loops: wool of any color and Iron Cable produce one White Brush with life=0; dye and any White Brush NBT produce one fresh colored brush. No invented colored-brush refill route.
paint.graphics: Original icons; original .75*(1-life/32) inventory dry overlay, suppressed for creative. Exact original dye palette for wiring.

bus.behavior: 16 independent loads, Rs=.05 ohm, shared across each edge. Bus-to-bus joins corresponding channels. Colored wire addresses its paint channel even with care off. Neutral devices address channel zero. Original no-care default. Saved 16 actual voltages, live 4x4 display and all-channel multimeter. Original parent bus watchdog follows a detached load; no invented per-channel destruction.
bus.graphics: Original cable.png, 3.95 by 3.95 px; source icon and dye tint.
bus.correction: Painting a bus changes its physical tint and optional color-care filter while bus-to-bus connections preserve corresponding channel indices. Original normal connection could cross-link a painted bus channel before appending channels 1 through 15; that accidental short is avoided.

scanner.behavior: Reads front block each original 20 Hz tick; one back signal output with 5 V/.1 A original NbtElectricalGateOutputProcess and Rs=.05 ohm. Fluid capability takes precedence over item capability, queried from the scanned side. Averages positive-capacity tank fill ratios. Inventory mode uses total items/slot capacity or fraction occupied. Comparator override precedes solid=1, air=0, other=1/3 fallback. Right-click toggles saved mode. No forced chunk reads. Original main/LED_0/LED_1 mesh, live multimeter and original comparator+Advanced Chip recipe.
scanner.modern_adapter: Forge 1.19.2 sided capabilities replace legacy IFluidHandler/ISidedInventory and the optional 1.7.10 HBM reflection fallback. Zero visible capacity yields finite zero rather than NaN.

finalRegression.scope: All required cases passed. Existing per-device focused/client evidence and its limits remain authoritative; this field does not claim every configuration was exercised.
